request: what does a linear transformation keep and what does it change?

p = draw_plane(stage)
i_hat, j_hat = draw_basis(stage, p)
sq = draw_unit_square(stage, p)
stage.caption("Grid lines: straight, parallel, evenly spaced")
stage.pause(1.5)

beats.intent: The grid sheared sideways, lines still straight and the origin fixed
beats.narration: Shear the plane. Every grid line is still a straight line, parallel lines stay parallel, and the origin has not moved.
beats.code:

stage.label(sq, "area still 1", direction=UP, color=YELLOW)
stage.caption("Lines stay straight; the origin stays put")
stage.pause(1.5)

beats.intent: Four evenly spaced dots on a line, stretched, still evenly spaced on a line

row = VGroup(*[Dot(p2.c2p(k - 1, 0.5 * (k - 1)), color=ORANGE, radius=0.1) for k in range(4)])
stage.play(Create(ln), FadeIn(row))
apply_matrix(stage, p2, [[1.5, 0], [0.5, 1]], riders=[ln, row])
stage.caption("Evenly spaced points stay evenly spaced")
stage.pause(1.5)

beats.intent: Two perpendicular arrows sheared: the right angle closes and one arrow grows
beats.narration: But lengths and angles are not safe. Two arrows at a right angle get sheared: the angle closes to forty-five degrees, and the red arrow grows from two to about two point eight three.

a = draw_vector(stage, p3, (2, 0), color=GREEN)
b = draw_vector(stage, p3, (0, 2), color=RED)

beats.intent: The unit square stretched into a parallelogram of area 3

box, area = show_determinant(stage, p4, [[2, 1], [0, 1.5]])
stage.caption("Areas change too, all by one factor: here 3")
stage.pause(1.5)

beats.intent: The two lists written beside the parallelogram: kept and changed
beats.narration: So a linear map keeps lines, parallels, the origin and equal spacing, and is free to change lengths, angles and areas.

stage.caption("Straightness survives; measurements do not")

request: how do you get velocity and acceleration from a position graph?

beats.intent: The height curve s = 4t - t^2 of a ball thrown upward
beats.narration: A ball thrown straight up has height four t minus t squared: up to four metres at two seconds, and back down at four.
beats.code:
stage.title("Position, velocity, acceleration")
ax = draw_axes(stage, x_range=(0, 4), y_range=(0, 5), labels=("t", "s"))
s = plot_graph(stage, ax, lambda t: 4 * t - t**2, color=BLUE)
stage.caption("Height of a ball thrown straight up")
stage.pause(1.5)

beats.intent: A dot running along the curve, fast at first, slow at the top
beats.narration: Follow the ball. It rises quickly, slows down, stops for an instant at the top, then falls faster and faster.
beats.code:
ball, trail = trace_graph(stage, ax, lambda t: 4 * t - t**2, 0, 4, color=YELLOW)
stage.caption("It rises, slows, stops at the top, then falls")
stage.pause(1.5)

beats.intent: A tangent sliding along the height curve, its slope read out
beats.narration: The slope of this curve is the velocity: four at the start, zero at the top, minus four when it lands.
beats.code:
stage.play(FadeOut(ball), FadeOut(trail))
tan = slide_tangent(stage, ax, lambda t: 4 * t - t**2, 0.3, 3.7)
stage.caption("The slope of position is the velocity")
stage.pause(1.5)

beats.intent: The velocity line v = 4 - 2t, crossing zero at t = 2
beats.narration: Plot those slopes and you get a straight line, v equals four minus two t, which crosses zero exactly at the top.
beats.code:
ax2 = draw_axes(stage, x_range=(0, 4), y_range=(-4, 4), labels=("t", "v"))
v = plot_graph(stage, ax2, lambda t: 4 - 2 * t, color=GREEN, label="v(t)")
top = mark_point(stage, ax2, (2, 0), color=YELLOW, label="top: v = 0")
stage.caption("Velocity falls steadily and is zero at the top")
stage.pause(1.5)

beats.intent: A tangent sliding along the velocity line, its slope fixed at -2
beats.narration: Now take the slope of the velocity. It never changes: minus two all the way. That is the acceleration.
beats.code:
slide_tangent(stage, ax2, lambda t: 4 - 2 * t, 0.5, 3.5)
stage.caption("Its slope never changes: acceleration is -2")
stage.pause(1.5)

beats.intent: The three formulas, each the derivative of the one before
beats.narration: Position four t minus t squared, velocity four minus two t, acceleration minus two: each is the slope of the one before.
beats.code:
stage.equation(r"s(t) = 4t - t^2", r"v(t) = s'(t) = 4 - 2t", r"a(t) = v'(t) = -2")
stage.caption("Differentiate once for velocity, twice for acceleration")
stage.pause(1.5)

beats.intent: The area values plotted as heights, tracing the parabola A(x) = x^2/2

mark_point(stage, ax2, (1, 0.5), label="0.5", direction=LEFT)

beats.intent: A tangent sliding along A(x), its slope reading out x
